subject: AWS listing benefit assertions, evidence request, and demo slate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing benefit assertions, evidence request, and demo slate

Team —

We need a quick pass on the benefit assertions that will show on the AWS product page for CloudOps (related account). Legal wants clean, support-able claims and Field needs evidence to take into co-sell motions. Two asks:

1) Benefit wording cleanup — put suggested short copy (1 line + 1 supporting bullet) for each claim we plan to publish. Avoid absolute language unless we can prove it (e.g., change "near-zero" to a measured stat).

2) Evidence pack — assemble a single excel matrix mapping each claim to supporting artifacts (benchmarks, evals, SOC2 excerpt, customer quote, test harness). Attach any artifacts we can ship with the listing.

Also: prospect asked for demo slots focused on private deployment and billing (long context throughput + private VPC). Marissa — can you propose 30/45m demo scenarios and a pre-demo checklist? Karthik — please add any partner co-sell hooks (marketplace entitlements, private offers) and point to the pricing footnotes we should surface.

Deadline: I'd like a redline + evidence matrix by EOD Thursday so we can get legal and product marketing to sign off Friday.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (requested) benefit-evidence-matrix.xlsx (stub), security-evidence-pack.zip (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing benefit assertions, evidence request, and demo slate

Thanks Sean — attached is a first pass (benefit-evidence-matrix.xlsx). High-level notes:

- Replaced absolute adjectives with measurable language (examples below).
  - "Near-zero inference latency" -> "Median inference latency < 100 ms (seq len 128) on c6gn.xlarge equivalent)"
  - "Unlimited scaling" -> "Auto-scale to 1000 concurrent streams per dedicated pool; burst to x capacity (see appendix)"

- Evidence linked in the matrix: benchmark CSVs, internal perf harness run ids, SOC2 excerpt (audit page ref), one anonymized customer quote (legal cleared).

- Security pack is compressed; includes SOC2 statement, KMS integration notes, and sample audit logs (redacted). Note: legal asked that we do not publish full SOC2 report on the listing — include an "Evidence on request" CTA and provide the HubSpot contact for security review.

Open questions for field:
- Do we want to surface longer-context throughput numbers on the product page, or keep those in the technical notes section? Longer-context throughput numbers vary widely by model — recommending technical notes.

If everyone is happy I'll push a copy to the Drive folder and link in the HubSpot record.

Kimberly Park
Principal Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: benefit-evidence-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 120KB), security-evidence-pack.zip (application/zip, 1.2MB)

From: John Doe <j.doe@cloudops.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Partner Enablement <partners@marketplace-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing benefit assertions, evidence request, and demo slate

Sean / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up and the offer to demo. A few clarifying Qs before the session so we can prep:

1) Private deployment: does the private deployment option support AWS PrivateLink / VPC endpoints for inference traffic? We need this for compliance.
2) Billing: do you support both metered per-token billing via the marketplace as well as private-offer committed capacity (monthly)? What are the typical contract shapes for customers our size?
3) Throughput: do you have long-context (>=32k tokens) throughput numbers or best-practice guidance for batching? We run large-document extraction pipelines; latency/throughput tradeoffs matter.

Proposed demo windows: May 12 between 10-12 PDT or May 14 14:00-15:00 PDT. Prefer the latter if you need extra setup time.

Also — please include any quick one-page security summary we can share with our infra/security team ahead of the session.

Best,
John
John Doe
Head of Platform Engineering | CloudOps Inc

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <j.doe@cloudops.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Partner Enablement <partners@marketplace-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing benefit assertions, evidence request, and demo slate

John —

Thanks — we can do May 14 14:00-14:45 PDT. I've locked that on Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min (I've selected the 45m slot).

Pre-demo checklist (quick):
- Confirm use cases (you mentioned large-document extraction)
- Provide a representative dataset or sample doc (if possible)
- Confirm whether you'll join with infra/security (we can bring a short security slide set)

Demo slate (45m):
- 10m: Quick company + Marketplace offering overview (Seán)
- 20m: Technical deep dive (private deployment, VPC/PrivateLink, throughput best practices, batching knobs) (Karthik + Eng)
- 10m: Pricing/marketplace options (private offer vs metered) + next steps (Marissa)
- 5m: Q&A and follow-ups (all)

Attachments: demo-slides-v1.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB) — contains a short security summary page and private-offer examples. Also linking HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

Karthik — can you prep a short slide showing entitlements and private-offer flow for Marketplace?

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing benefit assertions, evidence request, and demo slate

Thanks all — good progress.

Quick follow-ups:
- Kim: push the evidence matrix to the Drive folder and update any claim language we plan to publish verbatim (so legal can redline).
- Marissa: confirm the Calendly booking and include the HubSpot record id on the invite.
- Karthik: please add the private-offer flow slide and the pricing footnote we should surface on the listing (private offer terms, minimum commit, cancellation).

Also tagging Legal for pre-review of the one-line claims: legal@redwood.com — please advise if any of the proposed claim wordings will require an extra approval step.

If we get the redline by Friday morning we can push the updated copy to AWS listing and attach the evidence bundle as "Evidence on request" with link to request flow.

Sean
